profile_text.body:
Snap Inc is a public company headquartered in Santa Monica, California, and trades under the ticker SNAP. On its website the company describes itself as believing the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate, and says it contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

The company is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001564408 and also appears under the name SNAP INC - A. Its litigation record lists 281 matters in California. The material available does not name specific products or AI offerings.
